reviews.text: Great app.. Amazing for an app that’s free. Other apps you had to pay for while this one had no ads, was free, and had great features to help you sleep.

Sleep sounds. Wonderful

Broken layout. Find my iPhone 16 Pro, I cannot reach the bottom two sound effects in this app. They appear to be brown noise and fan, but there is simply no way to scroll the screen and have it hold long enough to actually be able to select them. Otherwise, they are below the bottom of the screen or hidden by the controls. Would love if this could be fixed and allow them to be scrolled up all the way.

This is a GREAT APP!. This app helps me sleep and helps me keep my mind of things I’m having problems with and YES I will highly recommend it! Use it if you have problems sleeping or if you need to take your mind of things you are having trouble with or just use it to keep you calm because it helps me to be calm when I get mad and yes you can use it if you have ADHD because I do and my ADHD id just a mild form of it but when it’s to quiet I need some kind of sound going on or if it’s to loud I need it to be quiet but if you have ADHD and you have a mild form like me I recommend the app!

Wow!. Free so far. I just downloaded and I am listening to the ocean as I type. I have a migraine and was looking for soothing, distracting white noise or music. This is excellent!

I can use it on my Apple Watch as a standalone!. It plays the Sleep Sounds directly through the Apple watch so I don’t need earphones. Great when I want to nap: all I need is my watch!

Thanks guys!
Great app!. This app is a great find for me. It my new meditation aid. I love the choices, which are quite authentic sounding.
Ease of use!. App is set up very simple, easy to navigate and use. Great app for what it’s designed for.

This is great!

Perfect!. I have used this app to help me relax for years. I like the update. But could you bring back the Drone and the piano sounds? They were my favorites. Thanks

Not able to play in background. Wide variety of sounds and the app description says you can play it the background but you can’t. I like to be able to play an audio book for about 30 mins at night when going to bed(at the same time my sleep sounds are playing) and then when the audio from my book stops… having my sleep sounds continue through the night. I had another app that allowed me to do this so I know it’s possible. But they changed things and now I’m trying to find another app . This one had promise…but the background feature is a deal breaker

Customizable Sleep Sounds. Every night I pull up some random YouTube “sounds of storm” video that will play for 6-8 hours. This app allows customizable sounds to be played on a timer of your choosing. I love it!
Crisp adjustable sounds. Easy to use!

Very enjoyable app. I really like the sounds, there aren’t any blatantly noticeable breaks. I also really like the customizable soundscapes. It is a very good accompaniment for relaxing, sleeping, studying and reading.
